placement: Existing OSM-derived taxi geometry from airports-features.json. Illustrative 15m centreline and 30m edge spacing, unknown width18m; airport-specific light availability unverified.
exclusions: Inside terminal footprints, near runway surfaces, and edge lamps within another mapped taxi corridor excluded. No inferred red stopbars, runway status lights or green/yellow lead-off sequences.
signs: Existing map name annotations must stay labelled as annotations. No surveyed physical sign position/text obtained; physical sign addition held.

mappedMastLimitations: OSM point and mast type retained. Height25m, fixture count/shape and light colour are visual approximations, not surveyed. Haneda international apron25m brochure does not certify T1/2 mast heights.
